scope: All 65 currently configured country codes and all 21 published language asset packs; source market and language metadata are live verified, geographic language mapping is a strategy candidate.
language_mapping_evidence: INFERENCE: proposed language segments, not API-declared market language associations or measured demand
unassigned_language_policy: Prepare templates only; qualify demand among speakers in an existing allowed country before assigning. Do not infer additional countries from a published language.
partition_rule: One prospective Search campaign per qualified country, with language-specific ad groups and matched language landing pages; not one budget per language and not simultaneous 65-country launches. No wildcard worldwide targeting.

platform_language_rule.fact: Starting September 2026 Search campaign language settings are removed; Search delivery aligns to ad/landing language. PMax language setting remains relevant to non-Search channels; Shopping is not controlled by it.
platform_language_rule.account_rollout: PMax Languages field observed and English selected; Search creation interface not verified
platform_language_rule.execution: Do not require a missing Search language selector; validate creative language, exact country, localized landing, query language and language performance. If selector persists, record actual rollout state.

cost_control.conversion_goal: Existing verified Purchase only after reconciliation; do not promote add_to_cart/page_view for bidding

economics.revenue: Retained merchandise after discounts/refunds plus retained shipping, excluding taxes
economics.unknown_cost_rule: No profit-qualified paid launch without actual basket/settlement/fulfillment/fees/refund evidence
economics.cpc_note: Planner historical low bid or low average CPC does not certify auction eligibility or profit.

negative_policy.intent: Sewing-pattern and how-to-sew requests for a finished-clothing campaign
negative_policy.language: Use explicit reviewed local phrases. Negatives do not automatically cover synonyms, singular/plural or translations; casing/misspellings are already handled by current Google behavior.
negative_policy.accent_rule: Review accent variants where needed; do not generate endless spelling/case duplicates
negative_policy.scope: Campaign-specific only after inherited lists/account negatives are read back; no blanket category suppression
negative_policy.review: Compare proposed negatives against positive seed terms, local finished-garment intent, actual search terms and cross-language false positives.

phasing.first_test: Select exactly one source-qualified country/product/keyword cohort from existing evidence; US/AU/CA prospects are alternatives, not winners.
phasing.next: Add one qualified country or language only when its own buyer path, costs and budget permit interpretable measurement.
phasing.remaining: All other country/language drafts remain queued and visible; no country silently omitted.
phasing.success: Native saved targets/ad text/negative matches verified, matched landing and selected variants pass, genuine valued purchase accepted; subsequent attributed retained contribution measured.
phasing.kill: Stop candidate promotion on wrong product/language/currency, unavailable shipping, exceeded authorized exposure/CPC control, unverified primary purchase or unsupported claims.
phasing.unchanged_empty_data: Do not rerun completed 18 native candidate tests or repeat zero-report audits absent changed evidence.
